US-119-HR8183.title: MATCH Act of 2026

actions.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 758.
Reported (Amended) by the Committee on Education and Workforce. H. Rept. 119-861.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 33 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

US-119-HR8183.description: To amend the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act to provide for the establishment of talent marketplaces.
US-119-HR8183.aiSummary: The bill would create a test program run by the Labor Department to give grants to state agencies or groups of state agencies. The grants would help build workforce data systems, talent marketplaces, and public websites that show job, training, and skill information, with privacy and security rules. It would also support voluntary skills assessment tools and require reports to Congress on the program.
